records.title: Circle's Arc mainnet brings StableFX, tokenized funds and institutional finance
records.summary: The Block reports Arc's StableFX service supports USDC, EURC, GBPA, JPYC and KRW1; tokenized funds including BlackRock BUIDL and Circle USYC are available for trading, lending and collateral use; DTCC planned tokenization of DTC-custodied assets on Arc in H2 2027; Aave V4, Morpho and Uniswap were available at launch; Circle minted 10B ARC tokens but had not decided a public token launch, while USDC remained the gas currency.
records.limitations: Secondary reporting; StableFX availability, fund collateral eligibility and DTCC plans require confirmation from official product/partner documents. JPYC is not SBI Shinsei Trust Bank's JPYSC. Future plans are not executed capital flows. No XRP integration or XRP collateral is reported.
